symptom: Firewall install failed with PositionalParameterNotFound on literal caret
mechanism: CMD escape marker ^ was embedded inside a quoted PowerShell -Command string and reached PowerShell literally
prevention: Do not embed nontrivial PowerShell in CMD quoted -Command strings

symptom: Windows self-test could not delete temporary SQLite database
mechanism: sqlite3 connection context managers committed transactions but did not close handles before TemporaryDirectory cleanup
prevention: Run self-tests on windows-latest, not Linux only

Future PC updates through ChatGPT-PC managed-app/update path
regression: Static guard forbids scheduled-task commands in final bootstrap
